notes.title: September 2025 Update Notes – Sept 22
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157904/03b37a105b31364683934a30167fac9498b06381.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This new update for [i]Mafia: The Old Country [/i]addresses several issues reported by the community. We will continue to monitor feedback and plan to include more improvements in future updates. Thank you to everyone who has reported any issues and helped make the experience better for all players. [i] [/i][/p][p]
[/p][h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Addressed a reported issue causing a trinacria to fall through the map, making it impossible to collect.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed a reported issue allowing players to buy the fox statue in Pasquale’s without enough dinari, preventing The Collector achievement from being unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed a reported issue causing the True Soldato achievement to fail to unlock at the end of the campaign if the player changed the difficulty to Medium and immediately back to Hard in the Pause Menu at any point during the playthrough.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1][b]Performance[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Various stability and performance improvements on all platforms.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1][b]Visuals[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Addressed pixelated shadows visible in the factory during Chapter 9.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1][b]UI[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Various UI fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1][b]Audio[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Various audio fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1][b]Platform-Specific[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3][b]Steam[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Addressed a reported issue causing "Sprint" to fail to be remapped if it’s set to "Hold."[/p][/*][*][p]The input mapping menu now allows you to bind several actions to the same key in order to match the default key bind layout.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941540/Mafia_The_Old_Country/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: August 2025 Update Notes – Aug 28
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157904/add0c99854d8a89423655dfffd27ba9ba6d78bb8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We're rolling out an update for [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] that addresses a wide range of reported issues and improves stability on all platforms. We appreciate your patience as we make these refinements, and we want to thank everyone who has given feedback and helped make the experience better for all players.[/p][p]
[/p][h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Addressed various instances of companion characters like Luca, Cesare, and others not performing required actions, resulting in blocked progress. If you encounter this issue, reloading your last checkpoint should resolve it.[/p][/*][*][p]Performing a takedown on a specific guard is no longer a requirement to complete the objective in the Customs Warehouse in Chapter 3 if the player is able to avoid it.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed reported instances of invisible collisions present in unwanted locations.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed reported instances of missing or misplaced combat covers.[/p][/*][*][p]General improvements to Enemy AI reaction timing, pathing, and behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]General improvements to Friendly and Neutral NPC pathing, animation, and behavior.[/p][/*][*][p]Various gameplay fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1][b]Visuals[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Addressed reported ghosting issues during certain cinematics when using upscaling.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual improvements to cinematics on ultrawide displays.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved hair physics behavior in various cinematics where flickering could sometimes be observed.[/p][/*][*][p]Visual improvements on various cinematics lighting, VFX, popping, and clipping.[/p][/*][*][p]Various visual fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]UI[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Addressed a reported issue causing the Main Menu background to revert to its initial state when starting a new story playthrough after completing it for the first time.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvement to contextual HUD functionality.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed several reported instances of missing subtitles throughout the game in all languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1][b]Audio[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Addressed several reported instances of audio (music/ambient/VO) not playing throughout the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed several reported instances of mismatched audio and subtitles throughout the game.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1][b]Animation[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Addressed several reported issues of animation popping, warping, and misalignment.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed several reported instances of Enzo or NPCs being stuck in animation states.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed several reported instances of incorrect animations playing during conversations.[/p][/*][*][p]Various fixes and improvements to Animation.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1][b]Localization[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Addressed the “Protection Agreement” note which contained repeated words.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed reported inconsistent translations across all languages.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Steam[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Addressed a reported issue causing DLSS Frame Generation to randomly stop functioning during gameplay, requiring a game restart.[/p][/*][*][p]Various stability and performance improvements on the PC version.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: PC Hotfix Patch Notes – Aug 20, 2025
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157904/db01b4555569197708d0ad7003bd23a25feada37.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As we continue work on a larger post-launch Patch, we have another small PC Hotfix Patch that addresses reported issues to improve stability. You can expect the more comprehensive patch soon.[/p][p]
[/p][h1][b]Cinematics[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Set the default value for Cinematic Framerate to Unlimited instead of 30FPS for new players. If you have already played the game, you should change this setting manually via the Graphics menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance during cinematics transitions when using Unreal TSR.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1][b]Performance[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Additional improvements to stability.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941540/Mafia_The_Old_Country/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Free Ride mode coming to Mafia: The Old Country as a free update
notes.notes:
[p]As our first order of business, we'd like to thank you, our passionate and fiercely loyal community, for making the launch of [i]Mafia: The Old Country [/i]a success. We're truly humbled by all the support and dedication that defines the [i]Mafia [/i]fandom; you are the reason we get to craft these gritty crime dramas, and we're eternally grateful.[/p][p][/p][p]Now that the game is finally in your hands, we're excited to confirm that [b]Free Ride mode will be coming to [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] via a free update for all players in the coming months[/b], which will add new activities and gameplay content. We'll have more details to share at a later date.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157904/caa2f997ab76684ed238c3b8d9684c453b6f5146.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, even after you've experienced Enzo's descent into the criminal underworld of 1900s Sicily, there's already plenty of reason to revisit the the Valle Dorata, whether it's to hunt down hidden collectibles in Explore mode or replay the story with the full Sicilian voiceover. Whichever you do, you'll still have every outfit, collectible, car, Charm, and other unlock earned during your first playthrough.[/p][p]
Since launch, [i]Mafia: The Old Country[/i] has garnered more than 3 million hours of viewership on Twitch, and players have quickly amassed some dizzying statistics:[/p][list][*][p]600 million shots fired[/p][/*][*][p]185 million enemies dispatched [/p][/*][*][p]17 million bandages used[/p][/*][*][p]10 billion Dinari “earned”[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]For those of you who have yet to uncover the origins of organized crime, [i]Mafia: The Old Country [/i]is available now. Also be sure to check out our list of [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1941540/view/523098989784990067"]Quick Tips[/url][/u] for how to survive and prove your worth to the Torrisi family.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941540/Mafia_The_Old_Country/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
